title: SCE payload schema (wire schema v1)
description: The JSON Schema (2020-12) of the payload of an event schema, which every schema unit declares as JSON_SCHEMA and `sce-codegen payload-schema` prints byte for byte (docs/adr/0087, section 1). This file states the subset of 2020-12 SCE writes: one spelling of each value of the payload's type, a record with every key required and no other, a 64-bit integer as the quoted text of its digits, every bound as the build resolved it. A text's maxLength counts characters and x-sce-max-bytes the UTF-8 bytes the type bounds. The text is compact with its keys in ascending order. It carries no generator stamp: it is a constant of committed generated units, and x-sce-source-hash, the source-hash of the files it is written into, names its inputs instead. Its second spelling, the GBNF grammar of the same type, has no schema file. Authoritative producer is sce-build/src/forge/payload_schema.rs over the folds of sce-build/src/forge/value_type.rs. The stability status of this surface lives in this header alone; see SCE_WIRE_CONTRACTS.md for the shared policy.

$id.description: urn:sce:schema:<document name>:<revision>, the SCHEMA_ID of the unit.

x-sce-source-hash.description: The source-hash of the files the schema is written into, when it is written into files that carry one.

description.description: What the schema says of its texts' bounds.

$defs.description: Each record the payload holds, once, under its document's name.

keys.description: Every key of the record, in ascending order.

value.description: The schema of one value: each form is told apart by the keywords it holds.

integer.description: A number of at most 32 bits, between its type's ends.

digits.description: A 64-bit integer: the quoted text of its digits, the pattern exactly its type's range.

number.description: A real; a float32 between its largest finite values.

enum.description: A closed enum: the names of its variants.

text.description: A text: maxLength counts characters, x-sce-max-bytes the UTF-8 bytes its type bounds.

bytes.description: A byte string: the Latin-1 text of its bytes, each character one byte.

optional.description: A value that may be absent: its element, or null. Its key stays required.

array.description: A list of at most its bound.
